sessions.time_accounting: Conservative upper bound: launch journal exception let worker complete; exit was not continuously observed; include full interval through first confirmed process absence

GPU_accounting: Owned process spawn-to-exit wall; includes initialization, cache, evaluation and idle within workers
GPU_time_precision: Includes conservative upper-bound component; total is not entirely exact
training_cost_scope: GPU-owned process wall includes cold initialization, full-Mcal data preparation, cache generation, evaluation, checkpoint I/O and worker idle; per-stage training timers are narrower and must not be summed with this wall total.
